page.content:
Robin's fellowship of outlaws in Sherwood and Barnsdale.

How Merry Men connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — Robin leads the Merry Men.
  • Artist: Little John — Little John is lieutenant of the Merry Men.
  • Location: Sherwood Forest — Later tradition stations the Merry Men in Sherwood Forest.
  • Artist: Friar Tuck — Friar Tuck is the fighting priest of the band.
  • Artist: Will Scarlet — Will Scarlet is a kinsman among the Merry Men.
  • Artist: Much the Miller's Son — Much is an early named companion of the band.
  • Concept: King's deer — The outlaws live on the king's deer.
  • Character: Alan-a-Dale — Alan-a-Dale joins the band after the rescued wedding.
  • Item: Lincoln green — The band wears Lincoln green as forest livery.
  • Character: Maid Marian — Marian becomes lady of the greenwood fellowship.

What is Merry Men?

The Merry Men are the named and unnamed yeomen who eat the king's venison, keep watch on the road, and answer Robin's horn — a forest fellowship against sheriff and abbot.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood, Little John, Sherwood Forest, Friar Tuck, Will Scarlet and Much the Miller's Son.
